protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers declared, depth 6, sparse directory store, matched-lambda retention
protocol.abort: K_STALL=32 consecutive squarings, armed by a guard admission

fix1_retention.law: a chain slot holds N ~ Poisson(lambda) records with lambda = S/D; the shipped store evicts the tail when the chain is full

poisson_tail.form: P(N>4) <= lambda^5/5! / (1 - lambda/6)  (Poisson tail majorant, exact rational)

matched_lambda_control.why: the fixture's bucket count is scaled so its per-bucket arrival rate equals production's; the same store, keys and protocol then measure chain loss AT production lambda instead of at a size-driven lambda

v31_unmatched_rows.note: the v31 census rows at the SIZE-DRIVEN bucket count; they are the reason flaw 1 exists and are retained as the unmatched-lambda contrast

fix1_retention.v32_assertion_replaced: 'retention 1 BY CONSTRUCTION because total capacity exceeds S' is withdrawn: retention is now the measured matched-lambda factor 0.998653

fix2_store.design: directory of 2^120 64-bit segment heads; 16-node segments allocated on demand; records and nodes in segmented arenas; no dense array sized by 2^128
fix2_store.representable: directory index 128 bits (fits the shipped unsigned __int128), segment heads and offsets 64 bits; no 2^130 preallocated pool
fix2_store.reprice: lookup, insert, export and init rows are charged on this structure; the overflow debit is the expected extra indirection

keys12.construction: twelve canonical 381-bit residues of a uniform Fp12 element, each reduced mod the subgroup order r
keys12.scope: coordinates sampled at the tower level (a uniform Fp12 element's coordinate vector is the state distribution); NOT a pairing evaluation

high_bit_degeneracy.why: canonical residues are < r < 2^255, so a 381-bit key extraction that reads bits above 254 is degenerate (single-bin histogram). The sampler detects this BEFORE measuring uniformity and bins the 255-bit residue span instead.

degeneracy_first.verdict: no degeneration: every element has twelve distinct lanes and every lane takes (almost) all 12000 sampled values

uniformity.binning: v*4096//r: equal-probability bins over the reachable residue span [0,r)
uniformity.note: a 2^-12-class collapse would put chi2 in the 1e6 range; the observed values sit on the null mean

mulmod.implementation: four 64-bit limbs: schoolbook 4x4 product (16 mul) + Montgomery reduction (16 mul) + branch-free conditional subtraction
mulmod.object: compiled here with cc -O2, disassembled, body counted
mulmod.why_executed_equals_static: clang -O2 fully unrolls both 4-iteration loops; the disassembly contains no backward branch, so every instruction in the body executes exactly once per call
mulmod.verdict: the v32 64-Ir figure is not an implementation bound; the ledger charges the disassembled body count

fix3_keys12_mulmod.coeff_derivation: 2 x mulmod33 (A += linv[kap]*a, D += linv[kap]*b) at the disassembled price + 12-lane load at 4 Ir

fix4_markov.derivation: a trapping window requires its 32 squarings to stay in a closed orbit of the walk map on the subgroup of order r (2^255). The number of point-pairs in a 32-step window is C(32,2) = 496, so P(closed orbit) <= 496/2^255 by the birthday bound -- derived from the field size and the window length, with NO measured frequency

measured_consistency_row.note: the census is CORROBORATION (0 observed <= derived 2^-246.0 per window); it is not the source of the bound, which reverses the v32 circularity

fix4_markov.v32_flaw: v32 converted 4497 measured guard admissions in 5040000 steps into an expectation; that is circular. The admission count is a mechanism statistic and is no longer used in any bound.

fix5_transfer_and_gap.bootstrap_transfer: the fixture arms are run at lambda_matched (0.2417) which is <= production lambda (0.2815) BY CONSTRUCTION of the bucket count, so the bootstrap population is the matched-lambda population: the resampled p5 applies at production lambda, and the retention factor entering it is measured at that same lambda. No fixture-to-production lambda change remains.

route_b_gap_law.law: pair weights (S-g)/N give a TRIANGULAR gap density 2(S-g)/S^2 on [0,S]
route_b_gap_law.verdict: still REJECTED (success 2.5e-32 << 0.39 floor); the row is now the correct triangular value, 2x the v32 uniform one

storage.note: REPORTED, not scored (memory is unweighted); stated plainly because the claimed computation is 141.98 bits

rounding.rule: every row is an exact integer ceil of its rational product
